title: Vectoroids
description: An Asteroids-style arcade shooter with vector graphics over a photo of Jupiter.

title: Atomiks
description: A remake of the classic Atomix: slide atoms around a maze to build molecules.

title: Brogue Community Edition
description: A streamlined, beautifully rendered roguelike: descend 26 levels to retrieve the Amulet of Yendor.

title: Freegemas
description: An open source Bejeweled-style match-three game.

title: Dungeon Rush
description: Snake meets dungeon crawler: lead a growing line of heroes through waves of monsters.

title: Powermanga
description: A vertically scrolling shoot 'em up with 41 levels and a huge array of enemies.

title: Azimuth
description: A metroidvania in space: pilot a small ship through a vast, hand-drawn vector world to find out what happened to Zenith Station.

title: Candy Crisis
description: A Puyo Puyo-style falling-candy puzzle game, open sourced by its author.

title: Chromium B.S.U.
description: A fast-paced arcade top-scrolling space shooter.

title: Cuyo
description: A falling-blocks puzzle game whose every level has its own rules and graphics.

title: FreeSiege
description: Combine blocks into siege units and send them against your opponent's castle.

title: Help Hannah's Horse
description: Guide Hannah through mazes to collect food for her horse while avoiding ghosts.

title: LBreakoutHD
description: A scalable HD remake of LBreakout2 with hundreds of levels and power-ups.

title: Li-Ri
description: Drive a toy train round the tracks, collecting all the carriages without crashing.

title: Numpty Physics
description: Draw shapes that come alive under physics to get the red ball to the star.

title: SDL-Ball
description: A colourful Breakout clone with power-ups, themes and a level editor.

title: Project: Starfighter
license: GPL-3.0 (code), free art and music (see LICENSES)
description: A side-scrolling space shooter with a campaign, upgrades and a story.

title: Violetland
description: Survive endless waves of monsters in this top-down shooter with RPG elements.

title: Water Closet
description: A puzzle platformer about plumbing: guide the water where it needs to go.

title: XGalaga
description: A Galaga-style arcade shooter.

title: Haxima
description: An Ultima-style role-playing game built on the Nazghul engine.

title: Cro-Mag Rally
developer: Pangea Software; port by Iliyas Jorio
description: Prehistoric kart racing through Stone, Bronze and Iron Age tracks. (Music resampled to 22 kHz to fit GitHub's 100 MB file limit; build it with ports/build.py for full-quality music.)

title: Empty Clip
description: A top-down sci-fi action RPG.

title: BreakHack
description: A short, fast roguelike dungeon crawler with a pixel-art look.

title: Freedoom: Phase 1
description: Four episodes of free, original Doom-style levels, monsters and music, played on the faithful Chocolate Doom engine.

title: Freedoom: Phase 2
description: A 32-level free megawad in the style of Doom II, played on the faithful Chocolate Doom engine.

title: Anarch
description: A small, completely public-domain Doom-like shooter with its own levels, art and sounds, written to run on anything.

title: SDL Sopwith
developer: David L. Clark (original), Simon Howard (SDL port)
description: The classic 1984 side-scrolling biplane game: bomb the enemy's buildings and dogfight their planes.

title: Jump 'n Bump
developer: Brainchild Design; SDL port by the Jump 'n Bump team
description: Cute bunnies jump on each other's heads in this frantic local-multiplayer platformer.

title: Nikwi Deluxe
description: A colourful platformer: collect all the sweets in each level while avoiding the enemies.

title: C-Dogs SDL
developer: Cong Xu and contributors (original by Ronny Wester)
description: Classic overhead run-and-gun: campaigns, co-op and deathmatch, remade from the 1997 DOS game.

title: Freegish
description: Physics platformer starring a ball of tar that can stick, slide and harden, using the free replacement data of the open-sourced Gish.

title: Bombermaaan
developer: Thibaut Tollemer, Bernd Arnold, Jerome Bigot and contributors
description: Classic arena bomber for up to five players on one keyboard or against the computer.

title: Blobby Volley 2
developer: Daniel Knobe and the Blobby Volley team
description: Two blobs, one ball: a head-to-head volleyball game for two players on one keyboard or against Lua bots.

title: Angband
description: The classic Tolkien-themed roguelike: descend a hundred levels of Angband to defeat Morgoth.

title: Neverball
developer: Robert Kooima and the Neverball team
description: Tilt the floor to roll a ball through an obstacle course, collecting coins before time runs out. All level sets included.

title: OpenTTD
developer: The OpenTTD team (based on Transport Tycoon Deluxe by Chris Sawyer)
description: Open-source transport simulation: build trains, road vehicles, ships and aircraft networks. Ships with the free OpenGFX graphics, OpenSFX sounds and OpenMSX music.
